why: Part of 2087 Webster State Park (stays in it): Lake View's 10 water/electric sites (068-077, campitks loop 510317, read 2026-11-06) have no entrance of their own from a public road. Their short spur leaves the unnamed paved park drive (OSM way 13224958) that runs ~2.2 km along the north shore between the 9 Road corner, where the west cluster is entered, and the end of 10 Road at the park's east entry (Esri imagery + OSM, 2026-11-06). The loop is mid-drive, 0.97 km from Hill Top's nearest pad and 1.08 km from Rock Point's, inside KDWP's single 'Oldtown Area'. 2087's note and site counts already include it.
name: Webster State Park (Lake View)
flags: Judgement call: Lake View could instead be folded into the new Rock Point entry. By the park drive it is ~0.9 km from the east entry (10 Road) and ~1.1 km from the 9 Road corner, so it shares both approaches; I left it in 2087 because it is nearer the west cluster in a straight line (0.97 km to Hill Top) and 2087 already counts and describes it.

Facts for 2087 (already stored there): 10 water/electric 50/30/20 A, back-in, 32-52 ft (076 is 32 ft), gravel (077 earth), all prime, 'River/Lake View: Y', showers and modern restrooms within 1/4 mile - campitks campsiteDetails (siteIDs 3518-3527), read 2026-11-06.

Access (OSM ways + Esri World Imagery, 2026-11-06): the north shore is one connected park-road system. Public 9 Road comes south from US-24 into the west cluster (Hill Top, Old Marina, Eagle Landing = 2087); an unnamed paved park drive (OSM way 13224958, no street name in Esri's address data) leaves 9 Road at the L Road corner and runs ~2.2 km NE along the shore, past Lake View's spur, to the park's east entry at the end of public 10 Road (the park office is 1140 Ten Rd).
